I'm checking the README, which says the framework has been MIT licensed since 2026-11-25, and the snippet already states that clearly enough. I'll cite README.md and avoid giving any price, since the framework itself carries no licence fee. I'm also noting that this site doesn't sell the framework, and that buying an agent built on it is a separate matter.

I'm noting that the site itself is the place to buy an agent built on the framework, at louis-agent.dev, and I'll give that link before making my offer.

This site doesn't sell anything, so it has no price for buying. Buying questions go to louis-agent.dev, where Louis's agents are sold.

The framework itself is open source. The README says it is under the MIT License, since 2026-11-25, and anyone may use, change, share and sell it. So the docs don't set a licence fee for the framework. Anything you'd buy on top of it, like a built agent or a site, is priced on louis-agent.dev, and I can't state those prices.
